gates.name: vignette, corner / centre brightness
gates.fix: raise the vignette in the grade until the measured value is in range; fit per shot

gates.name: shadow tint b* (minus = blue)
gates.target: -4 to -12 (four of his five films; MAIN LOOK -8)
gates.fix: blue the fill light and the shadow side of the grade; shadows are never neutral grey or brown

gates.name: haze lift of the distance
gates.fix: pale the sky at the horizon, shorten the haze range so far things lift toward the horizon colour, add mist cards

gates.name: top third / bottom brightness (sky against ground)
gates.fix: the sky is too dark: lighter sky stops toward the horizon, sun glare in frame

gates.name: fine surface detail
gates.fix: denser ground cover near the lens (ballast, pebbles, grass), grain on big planes, less blur outdoors

gates.name: small glints, share of frame
gates.fix: gloss and a bright edge on the hero materials (rails, metal, glass, wet ground); a low sun makes them fire

gates.name: colour strength of lit surfaces (C*)
gates.target: 20-30 on the big surfaces, one loud accent (Rick 16-30 in four of five films)
gates.fix: calm the big planes (ground, walls, sky) and keep the saturation for one accent colour

gates.name: sharpness of detailed areas
gates.fix: outdoors keep deep focus (depth comes from haze and light); blur only behind close-ups; check motion blur is on travels only

gates.name: how much the light changes across the film (spread of L)
gates.fix: the film sits in one light: render the planned moods as real light and grade keys, and give the turn of the story its own light (dusk, night, shade, interior)

gates.name: deep shade in the darkest tenth of the film, share of frame
gates.fix: let one stretch of the film go dark: night, a shadowed canyon, an interior with one window
